Select exactly 8 distinct field IDs from the supplied baseline variables for a classifier restricted to a few measurements. Rank the selected IDs by expected usefulness and complementarity for this task. Use only the measurement descriptions and task. Return JSON with the single key "order" containing the ordered field IDs. No patient records or labels are supplied.
{"task": "Using the enrollment visit in early pregnancy, anticipate a delivery before 37 gestational weeks among live births.", "fields": {"F4": {"description": "Body mass index at enrollment", "name": "BMI"}, "F6": {"description": "History of alcohol use", "name": "Use.Alc"}, "F11": {"description": "Prior spontaneous abortion", "name": "Spont.ab"}, "F1": {"description": "Randomized periodontal treatment assignment", "name": "Group"}, "F5": {"description": "History of tobacco use", "name": "Use.Tob"}, "F8": {"description": "Previous pregnancy", "name": "Prev.preg"}, "F0": {"description": "Maternal age at enrollment", "name": "Age"}, "F15": {"description": "Baseline percentage of sites with pocket depth at least four mm", "name": "BL..PD.4"}, "F2": {"description": "Pre-existing chronic hypertension", "name": "Hypertension"}, "F12": {"description": "Prior induced abortion", "name": "Induced.ab"}, "F14": {"description": "Baseline mean periodontal pocket depth", "name": "BL.PD.avg"}, "F3": {"description": "Baseline history of diabetes", "name": "Diabetes"}, "F7": {"description": "History of drug addiction", "name": "Drug.Add"}, "F10": {"description": "Any previous stillbirth", "name": "Any.stillbirth"}, "F13": {"description": "Percentage of sites with bleeding on probing at baseline", "name": "BL..BOP"}, "F9": {"description": "Previous live preterm birth", "name": "Live.PTB"}}}
